# Core semantic corpus v0

This manifest extends the Case 01 evaluation contract across twelve fixed
conversations. It is an offline evaluation corpus, not a graph or runtime
input.

The corpus intentionally spans business strategy, career, family, ethics,
money, research, and one short product-governance exchange. Every source is a
complete captured conversation. Source hashes are locked in `manifest.json`;
every required observation is backed by a literal span in its source file.

The annotations are provisional source-first research judgments. They measure
literal source-grounded recovery in the appropriate semantic family. They do
not claim exhaustive semantic truth or decision quality.
